indexes.name: AnalyticsCollectionDemand_quarantine_pending_idx
indexes.predicate: (("completedAt" IS NULL) AND ("quarantinedAt" IS NOT NULL))

indexes.name: SubscriberDirectoryMaintenanceSignal_legacy_yield_idx
indexes.predicate: ((attempts >= 100) AND (("lastError" IS NULL) OR (("lastError")::text = ANY ((ARRAY['subscriber_recovery_budget_exhausted'::character varying, 'maintenance_budget_exhausted'::character varying, 'publication_debt'::character varying])::text[]))))

indexes.name: SubscriberDirectoryMaintenanceSignal_structural_retry_idx
indexes.predicate: (((kind)::text = 'RECOVERY'::text) AND (attempts >= 100) AND (("lastError")::text ~ '^Subscriber publication generation [0-9]+ is stale behind allocated generation [0-9]+$'::text))

indexes.name: TeamPpvPurchaseLedger_retention_compact_v8_idx
indexes.predicate: (("compactedAt" IS NULL) AND ("historicalFactVersion" = 'team_money_fact_v2'::text) AND ("historicalFactProjectedAt" IS NOT NULL) AND (status = ANY (ARRAY['resolved'::text, 'expired'::text, 'attributed'::text, 'unresolved'::text, 'rejected'::text, 'creator_revenue'::text])))

indexes.name: TeamTipLedger_retention_compact_v8_idx
indexes.predicate: (("compactedAt" IS NULL) AND ("historicalFactVersion" = 'team_money_fact_v2'::text) AND ("historicalFactProjectedAt" IS NOT NULL))

indexes.name: DomainWorkItem_notification_refresh_recovery_idx
indexes.predicate: ((state = 'RECONCILE_REQUIRED'::text) AND ("terminalCause" = 'RETRY_EXHAUSTED:NOTIFICATION_BUMP_PROJECTION_FAILED:FAN_DATA_REFRESH_BACKLOG_FULL'::text) AND ("workClass" = ANY (ARRAY['NOTIFICATION_CONSEQUENCES'::text, 'NOTIFICATION_CONSEQUENCES_V2'::text, 'NOTIFICATION_FACT_RECEIPTS'::text])) AND (("lastRepair" ->> 'kind'::text) IS DISTINCT FROM 'notification_refresh_capacity_recovery_v1'::text))
